name: agent-skill-creator
title_zh: 把口头流程变成能跑的跨平台技能，三步内交付
tagline_zh: 把任何工作流写成一次、装到 17 个平台：Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini 全兼容的 skill 铸造机。
tagline_en: Write a workflow once, install it on 17 platforms — a skill foundry compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more.
desc_en: Create cross-platform agent skills from workflow descriptions. Activates when users ask to create an agent, automate a repetitive workflow, create a custom skill, or need advanced agent creation. Triggers on phrases like create agent for, automate workflow, create skill for, every day I have to, daily I need to, turn process into agent, need to automate, create a cross-platform skill, validate thi
why_zh: 跨平台是 skill 生态的下一站，这件把「一处编写到处运行」提前做出来了。
why_en: Cross-platform is the ecosystem's next stop; this ships write-once-run-anywhere early.
limit_zh: 17 个平台里只有 12 个原样能装，Cursor、Windsurf 等 4 个要转格式，Zed、Aider 等 4 个得你手抄进配置。校验和安全扫描都是 python3 脚本，过了它会直接装进你的配置目录。
limit_en: Of 17 platforms only 12 install SKILL.md as-is; 4 (Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Junie) are auto-rewritten and 4 (Zed, Augment, Aider, Continue) need manual copying. Validation and security scan are python3 scripts; it auto-installs on pass.
title_en: Turn spoken workflows into installable cross-platform.
